graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: Every article in the complete public home index.
graphic_summaries.completeness: All 35 index articles adjudicated; tutorial/sketch collections selected and export/introduction utilities explicitly excluded.

graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: All 149 canonical project pages in the official portfolio, including all 80 explicitly labelled series.
graphic_summaries.completeness: Every index page adjudicated. All computationally identified series/projects selected; purely hand-made or technically unestablished pieces explicitly excluded. Dedicated page gallery data and captions were read from the site’s embedded public CMS data; placeholders and global OG graphics omitted.

graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: All dedicated writing/project links in the home index, all generative-algorithm chapters, six plotter-drawing project groups and the linked plot archive.
graphic_summaries.completeness: Every accessible index entry adjudicated. Canvas-only articles are individually marked inaccessible for static-image selection; one separate genlog host is unavailable. No claim that missing imagery means a missing technique. Error Prints and Drift Prints pages remain reachable but their actual artwork assets return 404; both are separately marked inaccessible.

graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: All 78 artist-defined Flickr albums (complete public API index), plus all three current primary-site zoom collections.
graphic_summaries.completeness: 77 of 78 Flickr albums sampled; the explicitly travel-photo album is excluded. Every album image page was enumerated before spreading samples across its ordering. Current website collections are separately retained because their works may differ from historic albums. Album overlaps are not claimed as independent techniques.

graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: All 34 published page records and four posts, plus individually named portfolio projects, CSS animation sequences and publication remainders.
graphic_summaries.completeness: Every dedicated page and named home-only project adjudicated. Publications/series are not collapsed into a few optical samples. Repeated commerce/signature assets excluded; collaborative/workshop and installation image roles retained. Physical rule-based design is included without claiming undisclosed computer generation.

graphic_summaries.inventory_scope: All eight WordPress tutorials; all 407 GenerateMe and 455 Folds2d Tumblr posts; every source technique tag, named script/early project photoset, and all seven Flickr albums.
graphic_summaries.completeness: Archive APIs were fully paginated before collection selection. Source-specific algorithm tags and named photosets selected; generic software/person/topic tags explicitly excluded. Remaining ungrouped single posts are inventoried as noncollection remainder rather than silently called absent. Source tag/photo-album overlap is explicit.

other_artist_summaries.denominator_note: 74 named top-level entries plus four named Interval children. Interval parent expanded rather than counted as a separate artwork; nine curatorial/non-output entries excluded.
51 distinct named projects in accessible primary index; fourteen legacy applet/canvas entries have only unusably small public thumbnail images in this pass.
47 creator-owned project cards. Dedicated generators plus one procedural dungeon-game example retained; thirteen other games/textual simulations explicitly excluded.
All 98 work tiles, including named film works nested in series; nine series navigation labels group these works and are not additional works.
Full Works archive paginated to final page9: eight pages of ten and one page of nine. Includes installations, physical realizations, animation and collaborative projects.

18+11 public project cards. Page2 HTML title says of6, but linked pagination ends at2 and directly checked pages3–6 contain zero cards. Ten articles/tool covers/community sites excluded after visual review.
All seventeen linked named series/period groups from DAM artist presentation, each with its detail gallery. Not a census of all museum holdings or her entire lifetime oeuvre.

Current portfolio has twelve slots: eight visual collections and four resource/documentation/product exclusions. Historical index adds two named Dub works and five non-output/compilation exclusions after deduplicating shared collections.
